answer: A payout is split so that 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The summit schedule is applied in walnut and lotus shows each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1091 identities would post 2133 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
